## Summary
Shahir Ahmed is a software engineer and M.S. Computer Science student at NYU (Sep 2026 to May 2028, expected). He was previously a software engineer at Sarva and a software engineer intern on FarmData2, and is ranked 25th of 600+ contributors to Mermaid.js. He works mostly in TypeScript, Java, and Python, with React, Next.js, Spring Boot, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and AWS.

## Experience
### Software Engineer, Sarva (May 2025 - Sep 2026), Carlisle, PA
Sarva is a startup that helps neighborhood grocery shops manage inventory by voice: owners track stock, get low-stock alerts, and see what sold by speaking in their own language. It also offers online ordering with pickup and delivery.
- Cut inventory time by 60% by building a voice assistant that lets store owners manage inventory in their own languages.
- Created 3 GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines that run 2,604 Vitest tests on 173 TypeScript APIs to catch bugs before production.
- Deployed 12 serverless Firebase Cloud Functions on Google Cloud Platform that retry failed payouts and restock abandoned carts.
- Lowered zero-result searches 7% by adding semantic search with OpenAI embeddings to keyword search for natural language queries.
- Reduced AI costs by adding Redis rate limiting and a token allowance per user to the Next.js API routes that call OpenAI.
- Built the product that put Sarva in the gener8tor and Meta gBETA accelerator and the Ship Tank and launchU finals.

### Open Source Contributor, Mermaid.js (Jan 2025 - Apr 2026), Remote
Mermaid.js is an open source tool that turns text into flowcharts and diagrams, used by GitHub and Microsoft, with 12M+ weekly npm downloads.
- Added 3 D3.js features with Cypress tests: data labels inside bar charts, Knuth-Plass word wrapping for journey diagram legends, and journey diagram title styling.
- Passed CI/CD checks and maintainer review on all 3 pull requests in the 200,000 line codebase to rank 25th of 600+ contributors.

### Software Engineer Intern, FarmData2 at Dickinson College (May 2024 - May 2025), Carlisle, PA
Paid internship on FarmData2, open source farm record-keeping software funded by the National Science Foundation.
- Saved farmers 12+ hours a week by automating crop logging with 18+ transactional Node.js REST APIs on PostgreSQL.
- Cut page load time by 60% on a National Science Foundation funded farm platform by moving 22+ Vue.js components to Vuex.
- Authored 25 merged pull requests with 30+ Cypress integration tests in Agile sprints to become the project's 2nd top contributor.

### Teaching Assistant, Dickinson College Computer Science Department (Sep 2022 - May 2025)
- Raised assignment scores 15% for 25+ students over 6 semesters of weekly Python and Java code reviews and office hours.

### Software Engineer (Volunteer), 84 Lumber (Sep 2023 - Jan 2024), Remote
- Converted legacy CBASIC to Python and Java with an ANTLR4 translator that walks abstract syntax trees.
- Co-designed a plan with 11 teammates to modernize 50,000+ lines of CBASIC that shaped the $9B retailer's roadmap.

## Projects
Listed in the same order as the projects page, strongest first.

### GrabPic
- URL: https://grab-pic.vercel.app
- GitHub: https://github.com/Shahir-47/Grab-Pic
- Event photo search. Upload a selfie to find your photos in albums of 500+ photos, matched in under 200 milliseconds. Built as 3 services (Next.js, Spring Boot, and a Python DeepFace/TensorFlow worker producing 512-dimension face embeddings), connected through Amazon SQS, with pgvector HNSW search, S3 presigned uploads, CloudFront signed URLs, Redis rate limiting, and Cloudflare Turnstile. Compute later moved to Shahir's home server behind a Cloudflare Tunnel, cutting hosting from about $85 to about $1 a month.
- Tags: Full Stack, Backend, Databases, Distributed Systems, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Vector Search, Security, DevOps & Cloud, Self-Hosting, TypeScript, Java, Python, SQL, Next.js, React, Spring Boot, TensorFlow, PostgreSQL, pgvector, Redis, AWS, Supabase, Docker, Cloudflare, Tailwind CSS

### PaperPulse
- URL: https://paper-pulse-nu.vercel.app
- GitHub: https://github.com/Shahir-47/Paper-Pulse
- Research assistant that picks the 25 most relevant new papers from arXiv, PubMed, Semantic Scholar, and OpenAlex for each user every night, ranked with neural reranking, and answers questions about them with retrieval augmented generation over pgvector and a Neo4j knowledge graph. FastAPI and Next.js; the backend and Neo4j run in Docker on Shahir's home server.
- Tags: Full Stack, Backend, Databases, Machine Learning, AI & LLMs, Vector Search, Data Engineering, DevOps & Cloud, Self-Hosting, TypeScript, Python, SQL, Next.js, React, FastAPI, Neo4j, PostgreSQL, pgvector, OpenAI, Cohere, Docker, Supabase, Tailwind CSS

### Home Server
- URL: https://lab.shahirahmed.com
- GitHub (live status page): https://github.com/Shahir-47/nitro-lab
- Self-hosted cloud on an Acer Nitro 5 laptop running Ubuntu Server. Runs the GrabPic, PaperPulse, and Queue Up backends in Docker behind Cloudflare Tunnel for about $1 a month instead of about $100 on AWS. No inbound ports are open on the router. Coolify builds each app from GitHub on push and configures Traefik routes; databases publish no ports. Private apps (Immich, Paperless-ngx, Uptime Kuma, Samba, Homepage) are reachable only over Tailscale. The public page is a Next.js app that streams host and container status with Server-Sent Events.
- Tags: DevOps & Cloud, Self-Hosting, Networking, Security, Real-Time, Frontend, JavaScript, Next.js, React, Docker, Linux, Cloudflare, Traefik, Coolify, Tailscale, Server-Sent Events

### Queue Up
- URL: https://queue-up.shahirahmed.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/Shahir-47/Queue-Up
- Social app that matches people by Spotify listening history, with real-time WebSocket chat. Java, Spring Boot, React, PostgreSQL with Spring Data JPA, and Docker, self-hosted on Shahir's home server.
- Tags: Full Stack, Backend, Databases, Real-Time, Security, DevOps & Cloud, Self-Hosting, Java, JavaScript, SQL, Spring Boot, React, PostgreSQL, WebSockets, Docker, AWS, Spotify API

### CoSign
- URL: https://cosign-nwwl.onrender.com
- GitHub: https://github.com/Shahir-47/CoSign
- Task accountability app where users can't complete their own tasks. A verifier approves submitted proof through a task state machine, and if a deadline is missed the AES-encrypted hidden penalty is automatically emailed to the verifier. Spring Boot, React, TypeScript, WebSockets, Docker.
- Tags: Full Stack, Backend, Databases, Real-Time, Security, DevOps & Cloud, Java, TypeScript, SQL, Spring Boot, React, PostgreSQL, WebSockets, Docker

### PandOS
- GitHub: https://gitfront.io/r/Shahir-47/abfsq8dhTm4Z/Custom-OS-Kernel/
- Operating system kernel in C for the uMPS3 emulator that runs up to 20 processes on 5 ms round-robin time slices, with semaphores, TLB-based virtual memory, system calls, and interrupt handling.
- Tags: Operating Systems, Systems Programming, Concurrency, C, uMPS3

### BitTorrent Client JS
- GitHub: https://github.com/Shahir-47/bittorrent-client-js
- BitTorrent client in Node.js for .torrent files and magnet links, with TCP peer connections, SHA-1 piece verification, and extension protocol metadata exchange.
- Tags: Networking, Systems Programming, Distributed Systems, Concurrency, Algorithms, JavaScript, Node.js

### Albatross (HackHarvard 2024)
- URL: https://albatross-hack.netlify.app/
- Devpost: https://devpost.com/software/albatross
- Built after two teammates had felt unsafe walking through parts of Boston. A navigation app that routes walkers around high crime areas, built by a team of 4 in 36 hours, with a working demo for Boston. Clustered 50K+ crime records into risk zones with MLflow and stored them in a Databricks Delta Lakehouse. Vue.js, Cloudflare Workers, and the Google Maps API.
- Tags: Frontend, Machine Learning, Data Engineering, DevOps & Cloud, JavaScript, Python, Vue.js, Cloudflare, Databricks, MLflow, Google Maps API

- URL: https://sweet-friend.vercel.app/app/dashboard
- GitHub: https://github.com/dmicz/SweetFriend
- Devpost: https://devpost.com/software/sweetfriend
